coordinate_system.name: GPMP local Northing/Easting + Elevation
coordinate_system.units: source units (metres claimed by publication; unverified here)

least_squares_plane.interpretation: ordinary least-squares plane over control points; NOT terrain

spatial_layer.marking: SOURCE POINTS / NOT A TERRAIN MODEL

model_contract.reason: network-level idealizations are justified by the sampled stations; terrain and monument surfaces remain unidentified

ellipsoidal_envelope.interpretation: descriptive envelope of sampled stations; NOT a terrain surface and NOT a statistical confidence region

plan_convex_hull.interpretation: boundary of sampled plan footprint; interior NOT surveyed

principal_axes.interpretation: descriptive frame of sampled control stations; NOT terrain

spacing.interpretation: sampling density of control stations; NOT monument density

assumptions: the 41 stations are one sampled network, not one population of terrain points
source units are used without datum conversion
the frame is descriptive of the sample only
falsification_conditions: additional control stations move the frame outside its residual bounds
an independently verified datum changes the axis ordering
limitations: no terrain, monument or surface geometry is implied
no datum or CRS conversion was performed
principal axes are not archaeological orientations
models.method: Jacobi eigendecomposition of the population covariance matrix

assumptions: the plan footprint boundary is meaningful for control stations
the hull interior is unsurveyed and carries no elevation claim
falsification_conditions: a new station lies outside the declared hull
an independent survey redefines the plan footprint
limitations: not a terrain boundary, site boundary or monument outline
no surface is drawn inside the polygon
models.method: monotone-chain convex hull in Easting/Northing through measured vertices

parameter_units.perimeter: source units (metres claimed by publication; unverified here)
parameter_units.vertex_elevation_max: source units (metres claimed by publication; unverified here)
parameter_units.vertex_elevation_min: source units (metres claimed by publication; unverified here)

models.validity_domain: boundary of the sampled plan footprint only

assumptions: the scale factor is a descriptive envelope choice, not a fitted confidence level
station scatter is treated symmetrically around the sample centroid
falsification_conditions: a measured station falls outside the envelope beyond its declared residual
a different scale factor is required by an independently stated criterion
limitations: not a statistical confidence region for a wider population
not a landscape or monument surface
models.method: centroid plus principal axes scaled by the declared factor

parameter_units.semi_axis_1: source units (metres claimed by publication; unverified here)
parameter_units.semi_axis_2: source units (metres claimed by publication; unverified here)
parameter_units.semi_axis_3: source units (metres claimed by publication; unverified here)

assumptions: the sample spacing describes survey density, not object density
source distances are used without a verified datum transform
falsification_conditions: new stations materially shift the median nearest-neighbour distance
an independent survey shows the spacing is an acquisition artefact
limitations: not the density of monuments, settlements or terrain samples
uneven campaign strategy is not removed by this statistic
models.method: all pairwise distances plus nearest and k-nearest station distances
